segments.name: Advice & Wealth Management
segments.description: Provides financial planning, advice, brokerage, and cash management and banking products to retail clients through a network of financial advisors.
segments.evidence: We provide financial planning and advice, as well as full-service brokerage services, to more than 3.5 million retail clients through our financial advisors.

segments.name: Asset Management
products: Institutional and retail separately managed accounts
segments.description: Through Columbia Threadneedle, provides global investment management, advice and products to retail, high net worth and institutional clients.
segments.evidence: Through Columbia Threadneedle, we provide investment management, advice and products to retail, high net worth and institutional clients on a global scale.

segments.name: Retirement & Protection Solutions
segments.description: Offers annuity, life and disability income insurance products under the RiverSource brand to clients within the Ameriprise client experience.
segments.evidence: We offer clients annuities, life insurance and disability income insurance products to meet their needs or current stage in life

revenueModel.text: Clients pay fees based on assets under management and account balances, plus financial planning, transaction, distribution and performance fees, and premiums on insurance and annuity products.
revenueModel.evidence: A significant portion of revenues in this segment are fee-based and driven by the level of client assets, which is impacted by both market movements and net flows.
